thinkingLimitNotes.minBudgetTokens: Anthropic rejects a budget_tokens below 1024 with a 400. When no budget of at least this size fits, thinking is omitted rather than coerced.
thinkingLimitNotes.answerReserveTokens: budget_tokens must stay below max_tokens (a 400 otherwise), so the budget is clamped to max_tokens minus this reserve, leaving room for the answer. Used by the direct Anthropic and Vertex Claude paths.

requestDefaultNotes.largeOutputThresholdTokens: Above 8192 max_tokens a non-streaming call can run for minutes, so the generate timeout is raised (unless the caller forwarded one).
requestDefaultNotes.largeOutputTimeoutFloorMs: Five minutes: the floor the raised timeout never goes below.
requestDefaultNotes.clientTimeoutMs: An explicit SDK client timeout. With one set, the SDK skips its 'streaming is required for long requests' pre-flight, which would otherwise reject a large max_tokens on a non-streaming call.

requestFieldNotes.scope: The Anthropic Messages wire, used by direct Anthropic and by Claude on Vertex. toWireParams() writes a request from neutral names; unset values and empty lists are left out.
